evidence_summary: Kessler urges participants to understand presbytery nomination processes, contest nominees where appropriate, nominate alternatives, and be present for votes.
Kessler stresses that the majority must show up at GA and describes coordinated participation as necessary for denominational direction.
Kessler praises the AIC report as comprehensive, confessional, pastoral, and a model for the PCA's future.
Kessler writes that the GA affirmation of the Nashville Statement was an action 'many of us did not support.'
notes: Collective statement but does not identify which individual NP members dissented. Do not assign this position person-by-person.
